# Spatial Measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SpatialMeasurement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A measurement that assigns a spatial property — coordinates, geometry, pose, or spatial extent — to a feature of interest. The parent of [`CoordinateObservation`](gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) and other spatial measurement specialisations. Realises the spatial side of [Principle 3](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-3) ([`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) ≡ [`Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md) ≡ [`Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the parent for any reified measurement assigning a spatial property — coordinates, geometry, pose, extent — realising [Principle 3](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-3) for space.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it directly when a coordinate/geometry assignment is meant (use the specialization [`gmeow:CoordinateObservation`](gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md)).

### How to use

- Mint a [`SpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md) (or subkind), set [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](../properties/gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) and [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md), and carry the result via the observation-result spine.

### Examples

- ex:m a [`gmeow:SpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md); [`gmeow:spatialMeasurementOf`](../properties/gmeow-spatialMeasurementOf.md) ex:place; [`gmeow:vantage`](../properties/gmeow-vantage.md) ex:surveyor.
